issue_context.title: how to unmask masked unit by systemd.mask= kernel command line option
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

When a system booted with `systemd.mask=foo.service`, then the service cannot be unmasked with `systemctl unmask foo.service`.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Not sure...

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
```
chmod -x /usr/lib/systemd/system-generators/systemd-debug-generator
systemctl daemon-reload
chmod +x /usr/lib/systemd/system-generators/systemd-debug-generator
```

review_comments: more often than not we call these "shallow destructors" `xyz_done()`. We probably should decide on a preferred naming and then sanction that in the coding style.
But then again we didn't even add to the coding style that _new()/_free()/_ref()/_unref() is what you are supposed to call constructors/destructors/reference counting calls...
`git grep` says that `_clear()` is used more often than `_done()`…

hmppf, having two ways how UnitFileInstallInfo can be allocated/freed is messy. In particular destruction, since who knows what unit_file_search() might initialize in future.

Why not just allocate it on the heap and use the regular destructor? This is not a performance sensitive inner loop, so the copies/allocations this costs really shouldn't matter...
Then in that case, it should probably be done the same way in the other place…
there probably should really `_INSTALL_ERRNO_MAX = -ERRNO_MAX,` here so that we cover the full error range. we do that at other places
